Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Minor burn, [OR]  TBSA < 20 %
  -  Age ≥ 18 years old
  -  Understands Swedish  [OR] or English verbally and in writing
  -  Mentally adequate
  -  Oral and written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients deemed not to be able to complete study protocol
